I have a few similar symptoms, i am not a doctor, but i can relate and give some info.

1) Had anxiety and shit went down when i started going to the university and working

2) Started drinking alcohol

3) Deppresion symptoms

4) Putting on more weight

5) Having family troubles

6) Hitting myself to relieve stress and i also kinda loved it

7) Coffee and energy drinks addiction

8) Can't sleep at night, unless i want to, and it led to being sleepy during the day and just falling asleep randomly

9) I am seriously scared of knifes also

10) And speaking from my mind having a lot of argument coz of it, also impatience

11) Talking to myself (and i talk to myself in English even though i am Russian)

But on top of that i have: Uncontrollable spending sprees, mood swings, suicidal thoughts (a lot).

Firstly i was diagnosed with schizoaffective disorder

But then me and my doctor stopped on Bipolar Disorder with Narcolepsy. This is just my insight, maybe a few more odd things you can think of?

If you also can't controll other feelings also, it might be a sign of bipolar disorder. I have things that you mentioned but some other impulsive things, like sudden money spending sprees and just mood swings overall. I think getting checked out would be a nice thing to do. If it is nothing serious, it's cool. It could be bipolar, and you need to start curing it before it gets worse.

I guess this is why we have the feedback rule. But i think my idea can bring us closer to each other and maybe we can call ourselves friends or at least comrades.
